title: Event
description: One event in ClashEngine's outbound event stream: a fire-and-forget POST to the consumer's EventStreamUrl as a single application/json body, authenticated with X-Api-Key. A consumer (e.g. a Discord bot) uses these to advertise live queue state and notify players. Events are keyed by in-game player name; any Discord account link / opt-in lives in the consumer. Exactly one of `queue` / `match` / `player` is present, selected by `type`. No delivery guarantee: drops on backend overflow, so consumers should tolerate gaps (a queue board self-heals from the next event). The `match.teams_locked` event has no `matchId`; correlate it to `match.started` by roster, and `match.started` to `match.ended` by `matchId`.

schemaVersion.description: Wire format version, independent of the match-upload schema. Increment on any breaking change to the envelope or payloads.

type.description: Discriminator selecting which payload object is present: queue.* -> `queue`, match.* -> `match`, player.* -> `player`.

occurredAt.description: When the event was emitted (engine clock).

queuePayload.description: Present on queue.* events. Carries enough state to render or edit a live queue board from a single event. `count` always reflects the queue's occupancy AFTER the change this event describes.

queueName.description: Globally-unique registry id for the queue: "{ownerArena}/{baseName}" (e.g. "lobby/casual_4v4"). Stable across Label renames.

queueLabel.description: Operator-chosen display string (e.g. "4v4 (Casual)"), falling back to the queue's base name.

gameType.description: Registry name of the game type this queue forms matches under. Null for legacy/test queues with no game type.

count.description: Number of players in the queue after this change.

capacity.description: Total players the queue's match shape needs (TeamCount * PlayersPerTeam).

player.description: In-game name of the player this event is about. Set on queue.joined / queue.left / queue.dwell_warning; null on queue.near_full.

reason.description: On queue.left, why the player left. Null on other queue events.

waiting.description: On queue.near_full, the in-game names of waiting players in queue order. Null on other queue events.

dwellSeconds.description: On queue.dwell_warning, how long the player has waited in the queue. Null on other queue events.

matchId.description: Match identifier (lowercase, hyphenated UUID). Absent on match.teams_locked (no id exists at proposal time); present on match.started / match.ended.

gameType.description: Registry name of the game type.

gameLabel.description: Human-readable game/mode label, e.g. "Elimination". Optional; the consumer falls back to gameType when absent and derives the NvN shape from the rosters.

queueName.description: Source queue's registry id. Present on match.teams_locked; null on started/ended (correlate by matchId/roster).

queueLabel.description: Source queue's display label, when known.

arena.description: Arena the match is played in, when known.

teams.description: Team rosters. On teams_locked/started, rank is the team index +1 and score is 0 (no result yet); on ended, rank/score are the final placement.

finalState.description: On match.ended, the terminal match state. Null otherwise.

startedAt.description: On match.started, when the match went live.

endedAt.description: On match.ended, when the match finalized.

durationSeconds.description: On match.ended, live duration in seconds, when known.

abandonedBy.description: On match.ended, in-game names of players who abandoned.

score.description: Team score (0 before a result is known).

discordAlias.description: On player.discord_link_requested, the Discord alias the player asked (via ?connect discord) to be linked with. ClashEngine neither stores nor validates it; the consumer performs the link.
